title: Say why the nervous child was not ready: its exit, last start-up step and error output
goal: A not-ready failure on Windows CI names how the nervous child ended or where it stopped, so the second cause can be named from one run
acceptance: The not-ready error names the exit code or signal, or that the child is still running at the deadline (pid), its last start-up step and its last error lines
Committed tests fail first: a child that exits early with error output, one still running at the deadline, one that stalls in a reported step, and the real Runtime with a database it refuses
The run log and a reproduction under load on Windows are compared with the 30 s ready deadline; the deadline is not raised without measurements
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 from B-126-T01 (1.5 h): read the run, reproduce on Windows under load, failing-first diagnostics. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-26.
